Name: Elliot_Girl Dialogue changes
Author: KeionDryke
Description:
Made this mod to go along with Adarin's Elliot_Girl mod http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/388/?

Changes all the dialogue for gender and changes Elliot's name to Elena.

[size=4][u]INSTALLATION

[/u][/size]Copy and paste folders into the Content folder for Stardew Valley
Overwrite any files it asks you to.
Don't forget to back up the originals.

To uninstall, just paste the original files in and overwrite.

This mod is not compatable with other mods that change character names.

There are still some things missing like when trying to open Elliot's door before 2 hearts. Still trying to figure out how to change that.
Also it will still say boyfriend after giving a bouquet.

If you see anything else missing, please let me know.

Don't forget to check out the dialogue mod I made for Alex_Girl by Adarin http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/395/?
